description: Source code for managing PTM (Packet Transfer Mode) links, including initialization, browsing, adding, deleting, and parameter get/set functions, as well as object and leaf definitions for a data model.

methods.name: init_ptm_link
methods.description: Initializes PTM link arguments with section and device information.

methods.name: browsePtmLinkInst
methods.description: Browses PTM link instances, synchronizing configuration sections and creating instances.

methods.name: add_ptm_link
methods.description: Adds a new PTM link section with specified instance name.

methods.name: delete_ptm_link
methods.description: Deletes PTM link sections or instances based on action.

methods.name: get_ptm_enable
methods.description: Retrieves the enable status of the PTM link.

methods.name: set_ptm_enable
methods.description: Sets the enable status of the PTM link.

methods.name: get_ptm_status
methods.description: Gets the operational status of the PTM device.

methods.name: get_ptm_alias
methods.description: Retrieves the alias of the PTM link.

methods.name: set_ptm_alias
methods.description: Sets the alias of the PTM link.

methods.name: get_ptm_link_name
methods.description: Gets the name of the PTM link.

methods.name: get_ptm_lower_layer
methods.description: Retrieves the lower layer device or channel associated with the PTM link.

methods.name: set_ptm_lower_layer
methods.description: Sets the lower layer device or channel for the PTM link.

methods.name: ubus_ptm_stats
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve PTM statistics via UBUS.

methods.name: get_ptm_stats_bytes_received
methods.description: Gets the number of bytes received on the PTM link.

methods.name: get_ptm_stats_bytes_sent
methods.description: Gets the number of bytes sent on the PTM link.

methods.name: get_ptm_stats_pack_received
methods.description: Gets the number of packets received on the PTM link.

methods.name: get_ptm_stats_pack_sent
methods.description: Gets the number of packets sent on the PTM link.
